item.title: SHEMM Coach
item.description: Today, let's talk Medication. Notes are empty, so start from what's true: medication only works if it's taken consistently and on time. Look at your day and pick a fixed anchor, something you already do every day without fail. Tie your dose to that anchor so it doesn't depend on memory or mood. If you've skipped doses lately, don't dramatize it. Just notice the pattern. Action: set one daily reminder tied to that anchor, starting today.
